questions.stem: Consider this setup: 11 - How many edges does the complete graph K_11 have?
questions.explanation: In a complete graph every pair of the 11 vertices is joined by exactly one edge, so the number of edges is C(11,2) which equals 55. The required result is 55.
questions.hint: Count unordered pairs of vertices.

questions.stem: On a sample assessment, 28 - A graph has 28 edges. What is the sum of the degrees of all its vertices?
